video.title: Video assets · News and launches
video.load_first: Choose a SpaceWeekly JSON content snapshot
video.edits_note: News: one-line title and scrolling summary. Launch: rocket, mission and four detail fields; minimum 12 s. PNG MOV preserves alpha and needs a Premiere check; original ProRes is available. Edits keep the source snapshot intact.
video.unselected_preview: This item is unchecked and has no number. Select it to preview or render.
video.failed: Rendering stopped: {error}; completed assets are retained.
video.dependency_error:
Missing video dependency: {error}
Run python -m pip install Pillow.
video.window_hint: Checked news and launches receive consecutive numbers within each type. Edit, preview, then render.
video.order_hint: Sort news by publication time and launches by original launch time, separately. Ties keep their order; missing or invalid dates go last in each type.
video.intro_logo_hint: Image, GIF or MP4/MOV; empty uses the sample mark
video.intro_motion_hint: Static logos only. Videos play once and hold their last frame; GIFs loop, without extra zoom or movement.
video.intro_saved: Template saved: {path}; name, subtitle, logo and motion are restored next time; dates default to the latest 7 days.
video.intro_ready: Preview ready. Play or seek through the full 7-second opener.
video.intro_note: Use an image, GIF or MP4/MOV logo. Play, pause or seek the preview; animated media loads in the background first. Short clips hold their last frame; GIFs loop. Templates save the name, subtitle, logo and motion. Dates default to the last 7 days.
prompt.guide: Set the news screening, summary and headline rules. Use plain language; the app handles the output format.
prompt.placeholder: For example: keep summaries under 100 words; state the event, then explain its significance.
prompt.help.filter: Rates news as high, medium or low value. The dashboard threshold determines which items are kept.
prompt.help.summary: Generates summaries and keywords for selected news. A blank rule uses the selected template.
prompt.preview.hint: A fictional local preview replaces placeholders only. It does not call AI or incur charges. The app adds article content and output requirements during generation.
prompt.sample.title: Fictional Mars probe completes camera testing
prompt.sample.summary: A fictional mission team announces camera ground-test results.
prompt.sample.body: Fictional news: the camera passed thermal-vacuum testing. Spacecraft integration follows; it has not launched.
prompt.invalid_template: Templates need name, filter and summary text fields. title is optional; older templates use the default headline rule.
prompt.variable.title: Title
news.event_date_check.hint: On by default: cross-check official announcements and exclude evidenced old events. Requires search and configured AI; adds time and API cost. Search failures or insufficient evidence keep in-range reports marked for review in the log. Rate limits pause further searches in this batch. Disable for publication-date filtering only. Date ranges use UTC days.
search.api_key.hint: Brave Search key, separate from the AI key
search.provider.hint: Used for event-date checks and terminology searches. DuckDuckGo may show verification pages; the existing Brave Search API option requires your own search key. Date checks do not use Wikipedia. Unconfirmed reports are retained by publication date and marked for review.
video_download.title: Video download
video_download.hint: Search Bilibili or paste a single video link. Sign in with a QR code and parse again for available quality. Paid, DRM or saving-restricted content cannot be downloaded.
video_download.keyword: Enter keywords or select a JSON mission
video_download.select_hint: Select a result or paste a link, then parse. Double-click a result or press Enter to parse. Batch downloads and other actions are in More.
video_download.rights: I have the right to use this material and the platform permits saving it
video_download.ready: Ready. Parsing requires the optional yt-dlp backend.
video_download.parse_working: Reading video information and available formats…
video_download.cancelled: Cancelled. Incomplete media has been removed.
video_download.canceling: Cancelling; waiting for the background process to exit…
video_download.parsed: Parsed. The highest downloadable quality is selected; you can change it and confirm usage rights.
video_download.needs_ffmpeg: FFmpeg missing; this format is unavailable
video_download.error_invalid_url: Invalid link. Only single Bilibili BV / av videos and b23.tv short links are supported.
video_download.error_short_link: The short link did not resolve to a valid Bilibili video.
video_download.error_keyword: Enter a search query of 1–200 characters.
video_download.error_search: Search failed or was restricted by the platform. Retry later, search on the website, or paste a video link.
video_download.error_dependency: yt-dlp was not found. Source: run python -m pip install -r tools/requirements-video-download.txt in the same Python environment. EXE: place yt-dlp.exe beside SpaceWeekly.exe or on PATH.
video_download.error_backend: Video parsing or download failed. Access may be restricted, formats may have changed, or the network may be unavailable. See details.
video_download.error_unavailable: No savable MP4 format is available in this session, or the video has access, live or DRM restrictions. Try QR login and parse again.
video_download.error_timeout: Operation timed out. Check your network and retry later.
video_download.error_format: Invalid format selection. Parse the video again.
video_download.error_ffmpeg: This format requires FFmpeg. Extract the entire Windows package and keep _internal/ffmpeg/. For source runs, add ffmpeg to PATH.
video_download.error_path: The download folder must stay inside the current Workspace.
video_download.error_output: The download process did not produce a valid local MP4. It was not marked successful.
video_download.error_operation: Operation failed. Check network access or folder permissions.
video_download.error_permission: The platform does not permit saving, the video is paid/preview content, or saving permission could not be confirmed. Download stopped.
video_download.login_hint: Scan and confirm with the Bilibili app. Windows encrypts the session for your current user in the Workspace. It survives closing and restarting; signing out deletes it. Expired sessions require another scan. Platform download restrictions still apply.
video_download.login_waiting: Waiting for scan (valid for about 3 minutes)
video_download.login_scanned: Scanned. Confirm login on your phone.
video_download.login_done: Signed in; session encrypted and saved. Parse the video again to update formats.
video_download.error_login: QR login failed or the platform rejected the request. Refresh the QR code and retry.
video_download.error_login_expired: The QR code expired. Please refresh it.
video_download.error_qr_dependency: Missing QR dependency: run pip install qrcode in this Python environment. EXE users need a new build containing this dependency.
video_download.login_unsaved: Signed in, but unable to save the encrypted session. Check folder permissions and your Windows user environment. You will need to scan again after closing.
video_download.session_expired: Saved session expired. Please scan again.
video_download.error_session_store: Unable to save, read or delete the encrypted session. Check Workspace permissions. Changing Windows user or computer requires another scan.
video_download.no_tasks: No launch missions (enable news to include them)
video_download.up_ids: Preferred UP UIDs / space URLs; comma-separated; blank for no preference
video_download.up_hint: Up to 10 preferred UP accounts. The list is saved. Preferred uploaders appear first, with the selected order within each group; other uploaders remain available. Add a selected uploader from More.
video_download.up_partial: Some UP APIs were restricted. Fallback covers only the first 3 public search pages; videos may be missing.
video_download.error_up_ids: Enter up to 10 valid numeric UP UIDs or Bilibili space URLs.
video_download.error_up_missing: Select a result containing an actual UP UID, or enter its space URL.
video_download.error_up_search: Selected-UP search failed and public-search fallback found no confirmed matches. Check UIDs and keywords or retry later; this does not establish that the UP has no videos.
video_download.error_preferences: Unable to save search preferences. Check Workspace folder permissions.
video_download.date_unrestricted: Manual search has no date limit; select a mission to match dates
video_download.demo_hint: Process all JSON launches in their own two-day windows. Prefer saved uploaders and allow others. Keep specific mission names; use rocket names for generic payload counts, then name variants if empty. Parse up to three candidates and save one highest-quality MP4 per task in the shared dated folder.
video_download.demo_working: Demo: finding videos for all launches in sequence…
video_download.phase_searching: Finding videos for the mission dates
video_download.phase_parsing: Parsing candidate and checking saving permission
video_download.error_task_date: Mission has no valid original date (published). Use dated JSON or disable date matching for manual search.
video_download.error_date_no_match: This search found no video with a confirmed publication date inside the mission window. Videos from other dates will not be downloaded automatically.
video_download.error_demo_task: Demo needs launch tasks in the JSON and Match mission dates enabled.
video_download.error_demo_rights: Confirm material usage rights before running the demo.
video_download.error_demo_candidates: The first three demo candidates have no confirmed matching date, access/saving permission, or usable format. Nothing was downloaded automatically; inspect the other results manually.
video_download.search_partial: Search coverage may be incomplete: UP fallback uses 3 public pages and dated search uses up to 5 pages. Videos may be missing.
video_download.batch_done: Demo finished: {total} tasks, {success} succeeded, {failed} failed. Folder: {folder}
video_download.batch_no_success: Demo ended: {total} tasks, 0 succeeded, {failed} failed. See individual reasons. Folder: {folder}
video_download.batch_cancelled: Batch cancelled: {processed}/{total} processed, {success} saved. Completed videos are retained.
video.launch_opacity_hint: 0% transparent, 100% opaque. Affects the blue panel only; text and white accents stay clear. Saved in the edited JSON.
video_download.confirm_rights: Confirm usage rights to download. Batch downloads are in More.
